It concerns the desk
Pet Travel Notice for Aurelia Skyways

Travelers with cats, dogs, and other companion animals should check in with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure. We help with booking, crate checks, feeding notes, and pickup details so the trip stays smooth from start to finish.

<<FACT F028>> Please keep travel documents ready and follow the crew's guidance on carriers, leashes, and calm handling. The safety coordinator also reviews common hazards and shares prevention tips with the team.

<<FACT F004>> If your pet needs special care, tell the desk early so the right steps are in place. For help with any animal travel plan, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
